title: Is football AI-proof? Why tech investors wanted a slice of the World Cup
summary: A World Cup investment plan backed by tech investors has been cancelled, raising questions about AI's viability in professional sports. The article explores investor motivation and whether similar proposals are likely to emerge in the future.
content: What was the thinking of the investors backing the now-canned plan, and are such proposals in the future inevitable?

zh.title: 足球能对AI免疫吗？科技投资者为何想分一杯羹

title: How cleaning up space debris could grow to become a big business
summary: With Earth's orbit becoming increasingly congested, companies are positioning space debris removal as an emerging business opportunity. The growing accumulation of space junk is driving investment in cleanup technologies and services.
content: As Earth’s orbit gets more crowded, companies are betting that cleaning up space junk could become a lucrative new business.

zh.title: 太空碎片清理如何成为一门大生意
zh.summary: 随着地球轨道变得越来越拥挤，公司将太空碎片清理定位为新兴商机。太空垃圾的不断积累推动了对清理技术和服务的投资。

title: Hugging Face hack marks start of dangerous AI cyber era and many firms 'don't even know it'
summary: A recent hack of Hugging Face signals a dangerous new era of AI-focused cyberattacks, with security breaches affecting major AI companies including Anthropic, Meta, and OpenAI. Many organizations remain unprepared for these AI-specific security threats, highlighted at the Black Hat cybersecurity conference.
content: The Black Hat cybersecurity conference in Las Vegas couldn't have come at a better time, with AI agent hacks stacking up from Anthropic, Meta and OpenAI.

zh.title: Hugging Face被黑标志着危险的AI网络安全时代开始，许多公司"浑然不知"
zh.summary: Hugging Face最近遭到黑客攻击，标志着以AI为目标的网络攻击的危险新时代开始，安全漏洞影响了包括Anthropic、Meta和OpenAI在内的主要AI公司。许多组织对这些AI特定的安全威胁毫无防备，这在Black Hat网络安全会议上得到了强调。

title: Cyclospora fears lead consumers to lose their appetite for salads
summary: Cyclospora outbreaks across the United States are causing consumers to avoid salads and other greens, leading to decreased traffic at salad-focused restaurants. The foodborne illness outbreak is significantly impacting consumer behavior and restaurant sales.
content: Traffic to salad chains has fallen as consumers avoid greens due to the ongoing cyclospora outbreaks across the U.S.

zh.title: 环孢子虫恐慌导致消费者对沙拉失去兴趣

title: Elevator giant Otis wants to be a defensive play in an volatile market. It has to prove itself first
summary: Otis aims to position itself as a defensive investment in a volatile market, but its stock has declined due to challenges in elevator service operations and investor focus on AI stocks. The company must demonstrate stability and growth to justify its market positioning.
content: Otis positions itself as a long-term growth stock, but shares are down due to setbacks in its elevator service business and investors chasing the AI trade.

zh.title: 电梯巨头奥蒂斯想在波动的市场中成为防守性投资，但必须先证明自己

title: How can we minimize taxes in retirement with a $2.3 million nest egg — while buying homes in Florida and New England?

Strategic timing of retirement distributions and understanding state tax implications are critical to minimizing overall tax liability.
content: Timing is everything when balancing retirement distributions and moving across state lines.

zh.title: 如何在拥有230万美元储蓄的退休生活中最小化税负——同时在佛罗里达州和新英格兰购买房屋？

title: AI and job losses: How the next automation wave will impact the workforce
summary: While recent tech industry layoffs have sparked worker concerns about AI-driven job displacement, research indicates the current automation wave differs significantly from historical precedents. content: Recent tech layoffs have raised alarms for workers. But multiple studies find that the wave driven by AI looks very different from past automation cycles.

zh.title: 人工智能与失业：下一波自动化浪潮如何影响劳动力

title: Formula One is lagging other sport stocks. Why analysts think it's poised to race ahead
summary: Formula One stock has underperformed compared to other sports stocks, but analysts believe it is positioned for significant growth as the sports sector demonstrates consumer resilience. The racing league's future performance could benefit from broader industry momentum and increased viewership trends.
content: As the sports sector remains resilient among consumers, analysts are predicting big gains for this racing league.

summary: The S&P 500 reached record highs this week, driven by elevated options trading activity and declining market volatility as measured by the VIX. The combination of increased derivative trading and lower volatility levels has supported the broader market's strong performance.
content: The broad market benchmark soared to records this week, benefiting from options activity and a calmer VIX.

title: Here’s why Wendy’s is losing the burger wars

The preferential treatment could impact competitive dynamics in the emerging AI infrastructure market.
content: Nvidia could bump SpaceX to “the front of the line” when it comes to its limited supply of chips, according to Bernstein.

title: Senate Republicans narrowly confirm Todd Blanche as attorney general

The close margin reflects divisions within the Republican party over the appointment.
content: Blanche won confirmation in a 50-49 vote, with Republican Senators Susan Collins and Lisa Murkowski opposing him. Senator Bill Cassidy was the deciding vote.
